text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—New Year's break. Of course, no Twinkle 
Series races are held during this time, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there! You can still do it! The 
real race starts right now...!!"

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
That's it, show 'em the pride of 
Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada)

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that was so close. Just one more push 
and we would've had it~. Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, but it looks like you can win next 
time.

Yeah, but it looks like you can win next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At regional racetracks, races are being 
held somewhere even through the New Year 
holidays. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even at racetracks not hosting the event, 
live broadcasts from the venue are being 
screened.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Spending the very start of the year 
cheering on the Funabashi Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is what our New Year is all about, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso went home to Funabashi and 
thoroughly enjoyed celebrating the New 
Year locally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The daily life surrounding races. That, 
too, differs greatly between the Regionals 
and the Central.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. About our aspirations 
for the Classic year—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'd like for the two of us to get on the 
same page again. What should we do?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since late last year, there had been 
one thing weighing heavily on my mind as a 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps it is a factor that could 
greatly influence Furioso's future...
choice_data_list: What do you think about the “turf route”?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The turf route... To be honest, I've been 
a little curious about it myself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, back when I was in 
Funabashi, I never even considered it. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Now that the environment has changed... I 
think taking on the challenge might be an 
option worth considering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Vodka, Aston Machan, and the 
others sparks flew along the turf route, 
thrilling the fans to no end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she came all this way on a special 
study abroad, I want Furioso to explore 
every single possibility.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer. For our first 
resolution of this new year, let's go with 
"challenging the turf division."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I won't throw you straight 
into a race. Once we get back to the 
Tracen Center, let's start by testing your 
aptitudes."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we still have a few days before 
returning to the URA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Since you've taken the time to visit 
home, let's fully enjoy the New Year in 
Funabashi until then. How would you like 
to spend your time?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying New Year's in Funabashi to the 
fullest... In that case, what we should do 
is...
choice_data_list: Exercising at Funabashi Fairy Tale Park
To go eat their famous sauce ramen

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi Fairy Tale Park... It's quite 
the famous local spot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A vast park adorned with various 
statues... Well then, let's go for a light 
run.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is... a statue of "The 
Little Mermaid", isn't it?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, "The Little Mermaid" is famous, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"The Little Mermaid." She fell in love 
with a human prince at first sight and 
came to the human world, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a tragic tale where that love goes 
unrequited, and she eventually turns into 
sea foam...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Departing all alone for the distant human 
world... I can feel a sense of kinship 
with that. However—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It is totally out of the question! To 
abandon the sea of your hometown and live 
somewhere else forever, that is.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I would never do such a thing. No matter 
what happens, I will definitely return to 
Funabashi in the future. Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Getting swept off my feet by a prince from 
another world is completely out of the 
question... My partner has to be local. 
Local, through and through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the Little Mermaid, Furioso seemed 
to possess an unshakeable love for her 
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Sauce ramen... I see. Since we're here, 
let's go try some of the local 
specialties."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, this is the one. Ah, this 
fragrance... it takes me back...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Well then, thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (D-Drag, draggg...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That was delicious... But it's really hard 
to explain this flavor to someone who's 
never had it before.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's not as sweet as typical sauce, but it 
still has that distinct fruity richness...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Eating this soothes my fatigue. Is this 
the effect of the fruit extracts, I 
wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Right?! If it helps with fatigue, I really 
wish the Tracen cafeteria would add it to 
the menu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After eating local specialties, Furioso 
was filled with even more energy.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A large shopping mall... Yes, it doesn't 
really feel like I'm back in my hometown 
unless I visit it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's just a five-minute run from Funabashi 
Tracen! Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Wah... As always, there are so many shops 
here that you won't easily find in other 
malls.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Our facilities here can't compete with the 
central Tracen Academy, but we won't lose 
when it comes to shopping spots.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's the pride of the hometown.

Yeah, it's the pride of the local town, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Waterfront development. Riding that wave, 
this mega shopping mall was built.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi is by no means an old town. It's 
a hybrid city where the old quarters and 
new developments blend together!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was at Funabashi Tracen, there 
wasn't a single day where I didn't stop by 
here...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's go shopping today for the first time 
in a while. There might even be some new 
stores around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us browsed all sorts of 
shops together without ever getting bored.
